ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, controllers and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN, UK HMT, EU CFSP, Australia DFAT and New Zealand MFAT sanctions lists, and Vanuatu domestic designations under the Terrorism (Prevention) Act; foreign, domestic and international-organization PEP status and close associates assessed under FATF Recommendations 10 and 12 with enhanced due diligence for medium-risk venture capital GP structures; VFSC fit-and-proper assessment considers criminal history, adverse media, regulatory actions and source-of-wealth evidence; ongoing transaction monitoring applies to capital call wires and SWIFT transfers.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry, Port Vila; name clearance filed via VFSC-licensed registered agents using the VFSC corporate registration system (online portal: https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Companies Act [Cap 222] s.13: an International Company name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd' and must be written in Latin/Roman script; a proposed name in Bislama, French or a transliterated non-Roman script must be accompanied by an accurate English translation and will be recorded in the typed English/Latin corporate register; hyphens, numerals and standard corporate tags are permitted; the name must not be identical or misleadingly similar to an existing registered name or a name reserved by another applicant.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / Banking / Trust / Trustee / Insurance / Assurance / Reinsurance (reserved for licensed financial institutions; prior VFSC written consent mandatory)
Securities Exchange / Stock Exchange / Financial Services / Fund (requires prior financial dealer license or ministerial exemption)
Government / Ministry / State / Sovereign / Authority / Council / Municipal (implies official patronage; prohibited)
Royal / Chartered / University / Institute (implies accreditation or royal dispensation; prohibited absent documented entitlement)
Co-operative / Building Society / Chamber of Commerce / Foundation / Partnership (prohibited or restricted to prevent misleading corporate-type inference)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Where VFSC rejects a proposed name, the registered agent may (1) request reconsideration in writing to the VFSC Registrar within 14 business days, setting out legal grounds and any ministerial consent evidence; (2) submit an amended name reservation for accelerated clearance without restarting the statutory interval where the objection relates only to a specific token; and (3) if reconsideration is refused, apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review within 21 days under the Civil Procedure Rules, or lodge an appeal to the Minister responsible for financial services where the refusal is based on public-policy grounds. Administrative resubmission fees apply per the VFSC fee schedule, and each resubmission restarts the 30-day reservation window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible - the statutory registered office may be the address of a VFSC-licensed registered agent, which operates as a de facto virtual office; however, a VFSC-licensed Financial Dealer (venture capital general partner) must maintain a substantive local compliance function, appoint a resident compliance officer and AML/CFT officer, and retain adequate books and records in Vanuatu; under the Commercial Companies (Economic Substance) Act No. 19 of 2017, an entity engaged in a 'relevant activity' must demonstrate economic substance commensurate with its income-generating activity, and a purely passive GP with no local staff or expenditure remains exposed to adverse substance assessment.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 65% probability of an unannounced VFSC on-site inspection within the first 24 months for the licensed Financial Dealer (GP) entity; 20% probability for an exempt, non-licensable passive IC holding vehicle; registered-office premises are routinely spot-checked during VFSC AML/CFT supervisory examinations under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap 70].

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Vanuatu), ss. 8-12 (incorporation and constitution), s. 15 (name), ss. 16-17 (registered office), ss. 33-46 (directors and officers); read together with the Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 225], s. 32 (beneficial ownership).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division — Ebatiuba, Rue de la France, Port Vila.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form VFSC-IC-1 'Application for Registration as an International Company' together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no maximum authorized capital restriction; the Company may be incorporated with an authorized share capital expressed in US Dollars and shares may be issued nil-paid or partially paid. No statutory escrow deposit or capital blocking account is required for an International Company under Cap 222.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the Company subscribe and accept the Initial Shareholder Subscriptions set forth in the Schedule, allotting Ordinary Shares to the Founding Shareholders for the consideration approved. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office of the Company be established at the office of its licensed registered agent and a local registered agent be appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the following officers be appointed: Director (Chair), Director (Chief Investment Officer), and Company Secretary, each to hold office until annual reappointment, with authority to execute account opening mandates, investment management agreements, capital call notices and all ancillary operative documents. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT these resolutions take effect upon issue of the Certificate of Incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — Online Name Availability Window, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two or three proposed corporate names bearing an appropriate suffix ('Limited', 'Corporation' or 'Incorporated') to the VFSC name screening queue. A name must be distinguishable from all registered, reserved and licensed names and must not imply banking, insurance, securities dealing or trust business without the corresponding VFSC authorization. The clearance must be obtained before drafting the constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of the applicant licensed agent
Certificate of good standing of the founding shareholder (if corporate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, resubmit up to three alternative names within five business days; if refused on prohibited-word grounds, remove the offending word or apply to VFSC for a written ruling under s. 15(2) of Cap 222.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public licensed in Vanuatu; VFSC-approved registered agent (for form instructions)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English with a self-declaring registered office clause, unrestricted objects clause permitting venture capital financing, fund management and general partnership oversight, and a standard articles section regulating issuance of shares, directors' indemnity and contractual waiver of oral resolutions. Have each subscriber's signature notarized and file a statutory declaration of compliance by the subscribed attorney.
required_dossiers: Statement of initial shareholding and paid-up positions
Statutory declaration of compliance (s. 8(1)(c) of Cap 222)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry challenges any constitutional clause (e.g., objects broader than permitted), amend the clause by deed and re-submit the statutory declaration; no additional fee applies for the first amendment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC Single Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies Registry Counter, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form VFSC-IC-1 together with the notarized constitutional instruments, subscriber consent, registered agent consent and proof of fee payment. The licensed agent submits the package; the Registry shall review for completeness and accuracy and issue the Certificate of Incorporation upon approval.
required_dossiers: Certified copies of notarized Memorandum and Articles
Consent to act as registered agent
Consent to act as registered office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried (deficiency notification), the licensed agent must file corrections through the VFSC portal within 14 days; failing remediation the application is deemed abandoned and fees are forfeited except upon written waiver request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Government Registration and First-Year Annual Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Finance Office / Government Cashier (Ministry of Finance and Economic Management), Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official registration fee of USD 250 and the first-year annual registry fee by telegraphic transfer to the VFSC designated government bank account, or at the VFSC cashier. Retain the stamped receipt and embed the payment reference in the application form.
required_dossiers: Bank transfer remittance advice or cashier receipt
Payment reference printed on Form VFSC-IC-1
Authorization letter from the licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where an overpayment or currency conversion discrepancy occurs, file a reconciliation request with the VFSC finance office attaching the bank remittance voucher; the VFSC processes refunds or offsets within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Registration Governance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry; Licensed Registered Agent for registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and public extracts. The founding directors then execute the first board resolution covering share subscription, adoption of the registered office and appointment of officers, and open the corporate bank account for capital calls with a licensed Vanuatu or recognized offshore bank.
required_dossiers: Applications to acquire tax-status exemption certificate (if trading outside Vanuatu)
Register of directors, officers and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a typographical error, lodge Form VFSC-IC-1R 'Application for Rectification of Certificate' within 30 days; if the annual registry fee remains unpaid the registered agent must settle it before the certificate is released.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: VFSC Investment Business Licence (Portfolio Investment Management and Venture Capital Fund General Partner Operation) — issued under the Companies and Financial Services regulatory framework

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Vanuatu Ministry of Climate Change, Energy and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 — Registration (Administrative Exempt); office back-office activities with no industrial development trigger assessment under Environment Act [Cap. 283] Schedule 1
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC atmospheric emissions; domestic sewage tributary to the municipal Port Vila sewerage network, solid waste disposal via VFSC-compliant licensed waste contractors; electronic and paper record destruction must follow the Waste Management Regulations 2012 limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services Authority; structural load and occupancy inspection by the Port Vila Municipal Council Building Section; workplace health clearance and annual certificate of compliance from the Vanuatu Department of Labour.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; official e-services and VAT return filing via the DCIR Online VAT Portal (https://dcir.gov.vu); separate licensing/registration of International Companies is administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty. Consequently, no domestic Tax Identification Number is mandatory for standard GP offshore operations. Procedure for any optional DCIR registration: (1) identify whether the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu (an offshore management fee invoiced to a non-resident venture fund is not a taxable supply); (2) if VAT registration is nonetheless required or voluntarily desired, file Form VR-1 with DCIR accompanied by the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, registered agent confirmation, minutes of directors' resolution, and local business address proof; (3) DCIR issues a VAT registration number and VAT certificate. For CRS/FATCA purposes, the IC, if considered a financial institution in its capacity as investment manager, must register with the Vanuatu Competent Authority through the DCIR CRS portal and obtain a Global Intermediary Identification Number (GIIN) with the IRS where required. No business license is payable by an IC in Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu domestic law contains no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election mechanism. Section 68 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] confers automatic and unconditional exemption from any tax or duty imposed on companies, including income tax and stamp duty, so long as the IC is validly registered and does not carry on business with Vanuatu residents (except to obtain professional services). For U.S. federal income tax purposes of the venture capital GP, the IC may elect on IRS Form 8832 to be disregarded/treated as a partnership in order to achieve U.S. pass-through structure; absent such election the IC is treated as a corporation. No Vanuatu statutory election is required or available to vary the IC's exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 33 of 1998 [Cap 247]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 in any 12-month period of taxable supplies; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold; supplies made by an IC to non-residents are exported services outside the VAT net.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping regime exists in Vanuatu. There is no mandatory e-invoicing platform. Taxpayers may issue paper or electronic invoices in the prescribed form; such invoices and supporting records must be retained for at least 7 years for DCIR audit purposes. The zero-rated export claim is substantiated via documentary evidence retained by the IC rather than through any electronic government clearance mechanism.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under sections 15–17 of the VAT Act [Cap 247], a supply is zero-rated where the supplier receives consideration and the goods are exported by the supplier, or the services are supplied to a non-resident and are reasonably regarded as supplied outside Vanuatu (exported services). A Vanuatu IC acting as general partner/investment manager of a non-resident venture capital fund will qualify for zero-rating on management and carried-interest related advisory fees provided the services are performed for and consumed by the offshore fund outside Vanuatu, invoicing is directed to the non-resident fund, and consideration is received in foreign currency. Input VAT incurred locally (e.g., travel, professional services) is generally non-creditable for an exempt IC unless the IC is registered and makes taxable/zero-rated supplies; if the IC chooses registration, it may claim refunds of creditable input VAT on the export of services, subject to DCIR verification.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Entry) lodged with the Vanuatu Customs Service (DCIR) for any physical goods exported
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill evidencing departure of goods from Vanuatu
Commercial invoice together with the underlying investment management agreement / limited partnership agreement
Inward remittance or proof of payment such as SWIFT MT103, bank credit advice, or fund capital-call funding evidence in support of the export consideration
VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and registered agent confirmation establishing the IC's exempt offshore status
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu operates no exchange-control legislation and imposes no statutory foreign-currency repatriation deadline; the 180-day benchmark reflects prudent compliance practice for export consideration substantiation. DCIR may audit zero-rated export claims and, where the export status is not adequately documented, recharacterize supplies at 12.5% VAT with retrospective assessment. Civil penalties for incorrect returns, under-assessment, or evasion range up to 200% of the tax evaded plus interest of 1% per month on unpaid VAT. Criminal liability for fraudulent zero-rating claims or knowingly providing false information to DCIR attracts fines up to VT 2,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 10 years under the VAT Act; for an International Company, breach of the International Companies Act trading restrictions can additionally lead to VFSC deregistration and immediate loss of the statutory tax exemption, with all previously exempt income becoming assessable to the extent permitted by law, and directors/agents subject to sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 253]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) supervises International Companies and licensing, while the RBV administers banking and payment-system oversight. Vanuatu maintains no active exchange-control permit regime for International Companies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for current and capital account transactions. International Companies may maintain foreign-currency accounts in USD, AUD, EUR and other major currencies, and may repatriate dividends, capital, interest, management fees, and liquidation proceeds without RBV approval. No withholding tax on outward remittances applies to Vanuatu International Companies. The only affirmative obligations are anti-money-laundering recordkeeping, beneficial ownership reporting under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2020, and sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender rule, no minimum conversion ratio, and no fixed time period for export proceeds in Vanuatu. Exporters are not required to convert foreign currency receipts into VUV or to remit them to a domestic account. Any repatriated proceeds flow through normal banking channels and remain subject only to standard customer due diligence and AML monitoring. This regime is immaterial to the venture-capital general partner treasury model.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency Corporate Operating and Capital-call Escrow Account (USD, AUD, EUR, VUV)
International Company Operating Account and Capital Contribution Account
Domestic VUV Operating Account with selected AUD/USD capabilities
Local currency VUV Treasury and Settlement Account only

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium. Offshore digital EMI platforms (e.g., Airwallex, Currenxie, Revolut Business) are operationally viable as secondary disbursement rails for USD/EUR payments, but they cannot replace a licensed VFSC-supervised Vanuatu bank relationship. Legal constraints: a Vanuatu International Company must not hold out as a bank, money-service business, or EMI in Vanuatu; investor capital should not be parked solely on an unregulated foreign EMI because this triggers enhanced money-laundering risk, negative shell-company indicators, and correspondent de-risking. Recommended use is limited to small operating payments and FX execution, not as the principal custodial account for capital calls.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory rule requires all directors to appear in person merely to form or maintain an International Company. Remote onboarding is possible when a Vanuatu registered agent and counsel act as introducers. However, licensed banks in Vanuatu generally require at least one director or authorized signatory, and usually the ultimate beneficial owner, to attend a face-to-face or enhanced high-definition video KYC interview. For a venture-capital general partner rated Medium-Risk Enhanced, banks will effectively mandate an interview of the controlling principals before opening USD/AUD accounts, along with original or notarized corporate documents and a certificate of good standing from the VFSC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-exempt International Company used as a venture-capital general partner; perceived shell-company risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized VFSC certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, current memorandum and articles, registered-agent certificate confirming the statutory office in Vanuatu, board resolution appointing signatories, executed fund-management and carried-interest agreements, and an independent Vanuatu legal opinion confirming the IC lawfully carries on venture-capital business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Investor subscription files are incomplete or contain offshore LPs whose ultimate beneficial owners are not transparent.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete LP KYC files including FATCA/CRS self-certifications, source-of-wealth declarations, bank reference letters for each LP funding account, certified limited-partnership agreement, capital-call notices, side letters, and a consolidated beneficial-ownership register identifying all natural persons owning or controlling the fund.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Atypical flow pattern: multiple capital-call wires from diverse jurisdictions are rapidly forwarded to portfolio companies or third-party disbursement accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital-call notice and LP drawdown requests, fund treasury policy, executed subscription agreements, forward portfolio-investment pipeline and commitment summaries, signed investment transaction documents, bank-required transaction mapping showing each inbound contribution to each outbound disbursement, and board minutes approving the treasury operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to or from high-risk geographies or unregulated counterparties in connection with early-stage technology investments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence reports on portfolio companies, sanctions screening results for counterparties and jurisdictions, commercial and legal vetting memos, negative-media searches, local-counsel opinions from target jurisdictions, and a board-approved policy rejecting or escalating sanctioned high-risk countries.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: LP capital contributions are remitted via corporate SWIFT MT103 from the investor's bank to the general partner's segregated USD/AUD account at ANZ or Bred Bank in Port Vila. The wire reference must include the fund name, capital-call number, and LP identification. The receiving bank requires the executed capital-call notice, LP subscription documentation, and an authorization letter from the GP. No RBV exchange-control approval is required. Payment purpose code should reflect 'capital contribution / equity investment' as prescribed by the receiving bank (commonly an ISO external purpose code equivalent to 'EQUI' or bank-specific 'Capital Call').
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Portfolio investment and trade settlements are executed over correspondent-banking channels: SWIFT MT103 for ordinary wires to portfolio companies in USD/AUD/EUR; SWIFT MT101/MT202 for high-value internal treasury coverage or intercompany funding; and commercial letters of credit issued under UCP600 via SWIFT MT700/MT710 where the underlying investment includes trade finance. USD clearing runs over Fedwire or CHIPS, AUD over the RITS via Australian correspondents, EUR over TARGET2, and VUV over the RBV local settlement system. All outbound wires require board authorization and a governing investment/trade agreement to evidence underlying purpose.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable foreign-exchange forwards with licensed onshore banks (ANZ, Bred, BSP) for VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, and VUV/EUR exposure
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV crosses concluded offshore where onshore VUV liquidity is insufficient
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for matched-principal venture debt, GP co-investment loans, or management-fee receivables
FX options and currency collars executed under board authority and subject to the bank's derivatives-eligibility criteria and VFSC licensing confirmation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return (Form ICA-AR) — confirmation of registered office, registered agent, directors, members, and share capital as at the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies and International Trusts Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after each anniversary of incorporation per section 99 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222); anniversary-based rule, not a fixed calendar date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of approximately VT 10,000 (≈ USD 88) per the VFSC fee schedule; continued default beyond three months after the due date triggers administrative strike-off by VFSC; reinstatement requires settlement of all outstanding arrears plus a restoration fee of approximately VT 25,000 (≈ USD 220)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and KYC Confirmation Certificate — filed by the licensed registered agent as part of the annual renewal cycle and updated on every share transfer or ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC via the licensed registered agent, under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Delivered together with the annual return, i.e., within one month after each incorporation anniversary; refreshed within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate statutory fine; non-confirmation may cause the registered agent to resign and VFSC to treat the company as non-compliant, accelerating strike-off; material misstatement or non-disclosure of UBO details constitutes a criminal offence under Vanuatu AML law

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: VFSC Licence Annual Renewal — Securities Dealer or Investment Manager licence held by the venture capital general partner entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Licensing Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 December annually for calendar-year licences; pro-rata renewal on the licence anniversary date where the licence was first issued mid-year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Licence lapses automatically on non-payment; operation without a valid licence is an offence carrying fines of up to approximately VT 1,000,000 (≈ USD 8,700) and possible imprisonment; reinstatement requires a fresh application and full fee payment

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit for International Companies under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222). A mandatory independent audit arises only where (a) the VFSC licence imposes audited financial statements as a licensing condition, (b) group consolidation or an investor/LP agreement requires certified accounts, or (c) criminal forfeiture or AML proceedings trigger a court-ordered examination. No statutory revenue or asset threshold applies to exempt International Companies.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB for licensed entities and any entity required to produce audited financial statements; simplified accrual record-keeping per ICA accounting-record rules for non-licensed exempt International Companies; no separate local GAAP divergence applies to International Companies in Vanuatu.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent conducts an annual beneficial-ownership re-confirmation for every member as part of the VFSC renewal cycle under Vanuatu AML law. Any transfer, issue, or redemption of shares during the year must be evidenced by an instrument of transfer and board resolution, recorded in the Register of Members within the statutory update period of 30 days, and reported with KYC documentation to the registered agent for inclusion in the annual UBO certificate. Bearer-share positions, where permitted, remain custodied and must be fully disclosed for AML purposes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges (where security has been granted)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,000 – 2,500 per annum (licensed registered agent and registered office, including corporate secretarial administration and maintenance of statutory registers; exclusive of government fees)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 – 8,000 per annum (incurred only where a VFSC licence condition or investor/LP agreement requires certified financial statements; otherwise nil for an exempt International Company)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no dividend tax, and no remittance tax on International Companies (ICs).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption: ICs registered under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] are exempt from all forms of direct taxation. No payroll tax, no net worth tax, no estate or gift duty. Indirect tax note: a 12.5% Value Added Tax applies only to taxable supplies of goods and services made in Vanuatu; fund management fees for offshore investors are typically zero-rated or out of scope. No tax holidays or preferential deductions are required because the headline tax base does not exist.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return and Economic Substance Declaration (IC-AR form) filed through the VFSC e-Registry online portal, exclusively via a VFSC-licensed resident agent. No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu because there is no income tax law.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 calendar days of each anniversary of the date of incorporation of the International Company; failure is calculated against the anniversary date, not the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered IC name and unique VFSC company number (e.g., IC-XXXXXX).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the certificate of incorporation exactly; non-resident directors may sign but the resident agent submits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A local registered office maintained by the licensed agent is mandatory; a PO Box alone is insufficient to evidence economic substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the Vanuatu resident agent acting for the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners cannot act as the resident agent; the agent must be a VFSC-licensed approved agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, issued shares, classes of shares, and consideration paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Par value and premium details; bearer shares are prohibited for ICs, so all shareholders must be identified.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Narrative and code describing the core activity, e.g., venture capital general partner management, fund administration, and capital call processing for early-stage technology funds.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The description must align with ISIC 6499 / NAICS 525910; mischaracterizing fund management as passive holding is a red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC is managed and controlled in Vanuatu, detailing local board meeting location, employee headcount, physical premises, and local operating expenditure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors' meetings for strategic decisions (capital calls, fund investments, GP approvals) must be held physically in Vanuatu; offshore 'paper meetings' are non-compliant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the Beneficial Ownership Register is maintained at the registered office and the ultimate beneficial owners have been disclosed to the VFSC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee shareholders must be disclosed; any layering through shell entities or trusts concealing the GP's natural persons is unlawful.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of AML/CFT policies, risk assessment, and records of client due diligence, fitting the Medium-Risk Enhanced classification for a venture capital GP.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Investor identity, source of funds, and capital call documentation must be retained for at least five years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Director declaration of accuracy, signed by at least one director or the resident agent with power of attorney.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: False declarations attract criminal liability for signing directors including non-residents.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers escalating daily fines under the International Companies Act and the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act; the Registrar may impose default penalties up to 1,000,000 VUV, strike the IC off the register, and pursue director personal liability. Repeated non-filing leads to automatic dissolution and confiscation of assets registered in the IC's name, with restoration only via court order.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends, distributions, or capital distribution to shareholders, whether resident or non-resident.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and does not issue tax residence certificates for income tax purposes because no income tax is levied. For third-party due diligence, the IC may obtain from VFSC a Certificate of Good Standing, Certificate of Incorporation, and a Certified Extract of Directors and Registered Office; these certificates, rather than a TRC, evidence status in foreign jurisdictions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on cross-border royalties and interest; no domestic tax law imposes WHT and no treaty overrides are needed. However, VAT at 12.5% may apply to royalties on IP exploited in Vanuatu, and foreign counterparties must independently verify the no-WHT position under their own anti-avoidance rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no transfer pricing legislation, no thin capitalization rules, and no statutory arm's length documentation thresholds because the income tax base does not exist. No Local File, Master File, or CbCR is required domestically.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Not statutorily codified in Vanuatu; OECD-endorsed methods (CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split) are nevertheless relevant only for proving commercial rationality and economic substance to foreign tax authorities and to the VFSC during substance review.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act No. 37 of 2022 applies fully. For a venture capital general partner, 'fund management' is a relevant activity. The IC must: (a) be managed and controlled in Vanuatu, with board meetings substantively held in-country; (b) have adequate qualified employees physically present in Vanuatu; (c) incur adequate local operating expenditure proportionate to income; and (d) maintain physical premises. A standalone economic substance return must be filed annually with VFSC. Penalties for non-compliance reach 2,000,000 VUV plus daily default fines, and the VFSC may strike off, disqualify directors, and require cessation of relevant activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the venture capital GP without any real workforce, local premises, local board meetings, or local expenditure, while claiming tax-exempt status; using the IC as a pure conduit with management and control exercised exclusively from Hong Kong, Singapore, or other foreign financial centers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act; VFSC may impose financial penalties up to 2,000,000 VUV, suspend the IC's registration, order strike-off, and recommend criminal prosecution for false economic substance declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for economic substance penalties; disqualification from managing any Vanuatu company for up to five years; court-ordered civil restitution of benefits; foreign directors may face travel bans upon entering Vanuatu and extradition risk for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Facilitation of Foreign Tax Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing the international company as an instrument to evade foreign income tax by concealing the ownership or income of the venture fund; backdating board minutes to falsely claim Vanuatu management; issuing false invoices for management fees without underlying substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Common law fraud, offenses under the Vanuatu Penal Code, and the anti-avoidance measures of foreign treaty partners; financial penalties of up to 10,000,000 VUV for serious economic crime, forfeiture of proceeds, and corporate dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of the corporate veil where the IC is used for fraud or evasion; directors face civil restitution, custodial sentences up to 12 years under the Penal Code for conspiracy to defraud, travel bans, and restraint orders over personal and corporate assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at the registered office, failure to file beneficial ownership details with VFSC, deliberate use of undisclosed nominees or bearer-like structures to shield the GP's natural person owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offenses under the Companies and International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act; monetary penalties per day of default and criminal conviction; refusal to register any further ICs or transactions; VFSC administrative strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident agent are each liable; imprisonment up to 15 years for knowingly providing false beneficial ownership information; travel bans pending investigation; disqualification from holding directorship in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting capital call wires from investors without customer due diligence, failing to verify source of funds, tolerating PEP-linked investments without enhanced due diligence, or maintaining a compliance officer and AML procedures in name only while fund flows use opaque intermediaries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offenses under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act No. 21 of 2019, as amended; fines up to 30,000,000 VUV for corporate entities, suspension of the IC's operations, freezing orders, and potential designation as a high-risk financial business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual fines for responsible officers; imprisonment up to 20 years for willful blindness or money laundering; personal liability to investors for consequential losses; confiscation of director personal assets derived from the illicit flows; travel bans and extradition exposure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a venture capital GP by soliciting investments, holding third-party money, or providing fund management services to unrelated investors without the appropriate VFSC financial services license; crossing from exempt non-resident activity into regulated securities dealing, fund administration, or money transmission activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Carrying on a regulated financial business without a VFSC license is unlawful under relevant Vanuatu financial services legislation and the International Companies Act; cease-and-desist orders, penalty levies per day of operation, forfeiture of fees charged, and criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize unlicensed activity are personally liable for all investor losses; fines and imprisonment up to 10 years; exclusion orders from the Vanuatu financial sector; civil suits by investors with reversed burden of proof on the director's knowledge.
